title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani turns down Anbu's apology, accusing him of ruining her career. She refuses his request to stay in the quarters and reveals her pain over his humiliation.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Police arrest Kalamma at the minister's meeting, leaving Paraman furious at Ilamathi. When Siddharth attacks Ilamathi at Kumaresan's house, Paraman steps in to protect his family.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Manjamalai gets possessed by God at the temple and blesses everyone while warning Rasathi. Azhagar and Poongodi then receive his blessings as a couple, and he vows to protect them.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Sindhu faints after informing Annapurani of her scorpion bite. Annapurani desperately tries a traditional remedy before taking her to the hospital as her condition turns critical.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Bagyaraj plans Ragavan's checkup while Suresh drops Ragavi to school. Revathi surprises Malar and Mathi at the park, and Malar informs them about Ragavan's checkup.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi questions Thangamayil's health while Senthil aids Saravanan. Muthu Sudar reaches the temple with Bhagyam's family and happily marries Kumar.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Pandian confronts Vannathi for telling Nila about Chozhan's desperate request for money. Chozhan is troubled after Cheran reveals that Vannathi has exposed his actions to Nila.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Concealing the truth from the family, Muthu leaves for the hospital with Meena for her surgery. Vijaya is left stunned when Rohini reveals the truth about Meena's surgery.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: While shopping, Tamizhselvi unknowingly enters Sethupathi's rigged lucky draw. Vasanthi receives the winning call, and the family joyfully celebrates their new car prize.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Saranya is devastated when Karikalan expels Arjun for refusing Swetha. Furious over his marriage to Madhu, her father attacks Arjun, leaving his uncle to take him in.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: On hearing of Indhira's illness, Murugan makes Rasam rice and gets it delivered to her. Kandhasamy firmly opposes Lakshmi's wish to get Murugan married to her brother's daughter.
